newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli army confirms soldier killed in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli army confirms soldier killed in Lebanon.

text.p: The Israeli army confirmed on Thursday that one of its soldiers was killed in a clash in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone on Wednesday and said three guerrillas were also killed.
The army said the Shi'ite Amal guerrilla group took responsibility for the clash in which three guerrillas and one Israeli soldier were killed and five soldiers were wounded.
Pro-Israeli militia sources in Lebanon had said on Wednesday that it was Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas who were involved in the clash with Israeli soldiers.

One source from Israel's 3,000-strong South Lebanon Army (SLA) client militia in the border zone said the guerrillas used machineguns and anti-tank rockets in the clash. They wounded five Israelis, one of whom died later, the source said.
The Israeli army also confirmed on Thursday that three soldiers were wounded in a mine blast in the border zone earlier on Wednesday.
Israeli troops and the SLA patrol the zone that the Jewish state carved out in 1985 to prevent cross-border raids.

Later on Wednesday, Lebanese security sources said Israeli planes twice raided suspected targets of Islamic guerrillas in south Lebanon after a Katyusha rocket fired from south Lebanon slammed into Israel. The rocket caused no injuries, according to the Israeli army.
